en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan, from Shuayb, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked himasws about a man who accused his wife, so he cursed, then accused her after the separation as well, with the adultery, is there a Penalty (Hadd) upon him?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, upon him is the Penalty (Hadd)’.
